title: POST /api/v1/feed/pairings request
description: A machine opens a pairing under the first group of the code it shows (`pairing`), until `expires_at`, replacing any pairing it had open. The cloud refuses an id another machine's open pairing holds (`pairing_taken`, 409), and the machine opens another code.

expires_at.description: When the code stops working, at most ten minutes on.
